leverage.exposure: No leverage is open and none is proposed. The balance is positive, the live offer is capped at cash rather than reaching into the floor, and if it lands the balance stays positive with room to spare. The fallback defender is sequenced deliberately behind it — that listing resolves well after the forward's, so the two cannot both land and cannot combine into a negative balance. Nothing here puts the zero-score-at-matchday-start rule anywhere near play, and there is a long runway to the next lock.

binding_gap: The binding gap is still the attack, and it is the same gap the live offer is aimed at. With only two forwards the squad is locked into a single legal shape, which forces a points-free midfielder into the eleven every week. Landing the forward opens a second legal shape that benches him, and that is where the gain comes from — it is a shape fix, not a slot upgrade, which is why it outranks every more expensive player on the board.

verdict.headline: No action this run.
verdict.detail: No action this run. The Conté offer stands at the full cash ceiling, is still uncontested, and resolves this afternoon shortly before he kicks off — there is nothing to raise and nothing to pull. The board has not moved since the last run: not one new listing, not one settled transfer. The substantive finding is a correction to our own bookkeeping rather than a trade. Matchday two is being played right now, not scored, and the previous run recorded it as finished. The lineup is locked either way, so this changes what we can claim, not what we can do.

sell.reason: Nothing to sell today. The designated first funding sale remains the midfielder with no minutes and no points, and the news sweep hardened that case rather than softening it: he is fit, but he has never come on, sitting unused through both matchday squads so far. He is still not sellable yet, because at eleven players any sale drops the squad below a fieldable eleven and triggers the penalty. He becomes sellable the moment the Conté offer lands and not before. The forward flagged as benched in a dated projection is explicitly NOT a sell on that evidence alone — one probable-lineup graphic against a strong opening matchday is not enough, and the fixture settles it tomorrow.

buy.reason: The standing buy is unchanged and remains the best thing available. It is the binding-gap fix: it converts the squad into a shape that benches the pointless midfielder instead of being forced to field him, and that swing is larger than any alternative on the board. Nothing listed beats it. The strongest defender available was re-examined this run and still fails, now for two independent reasons rather than one: he cannot be unwound before the lock without gutting the eleven, and his headline average turns out to be a two-match figure inflated by a home thrashing of a promoted side, with a heavy defeat as the other half. The most expensive midfielder on the board fails on the same unwind arithmetic, more severely — no single sale in the squad could cover the hole he would open, which would leave a negative balance at the lock and score nothing at all. Everything else listed is either cheaper than our target and worse, or carries no points record whatsoever.

standing.name: Maximilian Rohr
standing.why: PRICE REVISION ONLY - replaces closed Bmu1irw, whose points case, fitness case, sequencing and abort conditions ALL STAND UNCHANGED. The single change: the ceiling is 11.433.624, not 11.343.624, because of the 90.000 matchday bonus credited 2026-09-04T23:20:19Z. That matters here and nowhere else: Rohr mv 9.726.134, so the old ceiling was +16,63% and the new one is +17,56%, and the measured Ebnoutalib clearing at +16,71% sits BETWEEN them - the extra 90.124 crosses a real measured clearing point. (On Conte the identical 90.124 crosses nothing, which is why B5fsu5e must NOT be raised - see Hjb3ujs.) CONDITIONAL FALLBACK, BID ONLY IF THE CONTE OFFER LOSES. DO NOT BID WHILE THE CONTE OFFER IS LIVE. The sequencing is clean and is the whole point: Conte resolves ~2026-09-05T12:51Z, Rohr ~2026-09-06T00:57Z, a twelve-hour gap in which the Conte outcome is known and the cash is either spent or free. No leverage, no sale, no overlap. POINTS CASE: Kickbase listing, prc exactly mv, ofc 0, st 0, stl [], DEF, Elversberg (tid 77, first-party tn). ap 87 off 84 minutes in the 3:2 MD1 win over Leverkusen, mv rising (mvt 1, tfhmvt +74.619). Squad goes to 12 = 1GK/5DEF/4MID/2ATT, 5-3-2 becomes legal and BENCHES AMOAKO, so fielded points go 1333 -> 1420 = +87, the gain being simply his own ap because Amoako contributes zero. FITNESS RE-VERIFIED THIS RUN on dated sources: Sports Mole 03.09.2026 starts him at centre-back at Gladbach ("Kristof; Gyamerah, Pinckert, ROHR, Gunther; Keidel, Poreba; Petkov, Onyeka, Campbell; Mokwa") with Seifert the only confirmed absentee; Ligainsider Verletzte-und-Gesperrte gives Elversberg only Seifert and Zimmerschied and does not list him. NEW THIS RUN, AND HONEST ABOUT IT: Elversberg's MD3 is AT HOME TO BAYERN (2026-09-13T15:30Z), so +87 is the accounting figure rather than the expectation for a centre-back, and Conte's kinder MD3 (Hoffenheim v Stuttgart) is a further reason not to pull the live Conte offer to chase this. ABORT CONDITIONS, ANY ONE OF WHICH KILLS IT: (1) the Conte offer WINS at ~12:51Z - cash is then gone and buying Rohr on top would need ~9,7M of leverage against a realisable unwind of only Amoako 1.569.143 + Widmer 1.852.587 = 3.421.730, leaving an unwindable negative balance that scores ZERO for all of MD3; (2) a source dated 05.09.2026 or later drops him from the Elversberg eleven; (3) his MD2 at Gladbach (kickoff 05.09 13:30Z) ends in an injury or a red card. Condition (3) is checkable before the bid must land - his match finishes ~15:20Z and the listing resolves ~00:57Z - so CHECK HIS MD2 RETURN BEFORE BIDDING.

standing.name: Bambase Conte
standing.why: RAISE the live offer from 10.400.000 to 11.343.624 = the FULL CASH ceiling, +22,08% over mv 9.292.405. Replaces closed Bduul6s (price revision only; its points case and fitness case both stand). THE POINTS CASE, UNCHANGED AND RE-VERIFIED: squad is 11 = 1GK/4DEF/4MID/2ATT, only 4-4-2 is legal, so Amoako ap 0 is compulsory in the XI. Conte makes it 12 = 1/4/4/3, legalises 4-3-3, and Amoako drops out: 1333 -> 1439 = +106, the largest single action available. He is also the best efficiency on the board at 9.292.405/106 = 87,7k per point (Rohr 111,8k is the next real candidate). FITNESS RE-VERIFIED THIS RUN on a dated source: Sports Mole preview 04.09.2026 01:36Z starts him in the Hoffenheim XI (Baumann; Coufal, Hajdari, Kabak, Bernardo; Avdullahu, Burger; Wimmer, CONTE, Daghim; Lemperle), TSG absentees only Asllani (knee) and Prass (muscle); Ligainsider verletzte-und-gesperrte lists ZERO Hoffenheim players; Kickbase st 0, stl []. WHY RAISE, AND WHY EXACTLY TO CASH. Georg's +11,92% sits in the bimodal dead space - uncontested listings clear at ~0% (measured 8 for 8), contested ones at +9% to +61%, so it beats only 1 of the 9 measured contested clearings while overpaying 1,1M if nobody comes. At +22,08% it beats 6 of 9. THE DECISIVE ARITHMETIC AGAINST LEVERAGE: the no-points-lost leveraged ceiling (cash + Amoako 1.569.143 = 12.912.767 = +38,97%) beats the SAME 6 of 9, because the next measured clearing above +20,96% is +48,28%. Leverage therefore buys ZERO additional win probability against the measured distribution while opening a negative balance and forcing the Amoako sale that removes the squad's only injury cover. Take the cash ceiling: no sale, balance stays positive, squad ends at 12 with cover. HONEST COST: if the listing stays uncontested he pays 2.051.219 over mv rather than 1.107.595 - an extra 943.624 burned for insurance on the only +106 on the board, against idle cash with no better use before MD3. Even at the full bid he is 107,0k per point, still better than Minjae, Nusa, Baumann, Guirassy and Lokonga.

killed_this_run.name: Maximilian Mittelstädt
killed_this_run.why: THE BEST DEFENDER TO HIT THIS BOARD ALL SEASON AND HE IS STILL A NO - ON AFFORDABILITY, NOT ON MERIT. New Kickbase listing 2026-09-05T01:02:05Z, DEF, tid 9 = VfB Stuttgart, prc exactly mv 26.562.688, ofc 0, st 0, mvt 1, exs 142353 resolving ~2026-09-06T18:11Z. Fit, no st flag. His own newest news item is 14.05.2026, i.e. LAST SEASON and correctly discarded, so the current-dated evidence is the club page alone - which under Hl06zvb is the unreliable instrument, but here it agrees with a fit/starter profile and two scoring appearances rather than contradicting them. THE ARITHMETIC THAT KILLS IT: cash is 11.433.624. He costs 26.562.688. That is a 15.129.064 shortfall against a squad of ELEVEN, and the unwind ceiling is what makes it fatal rather than merely tight - one buy permits exactly one sale, so the only way back to a positive balance before the MD3 lock is a single sale of 15.1M+, and the only players worth that are Baumann 17.257.467 (selling the ONLY goalkeeper is illegal), Matsima 14.268.347 (not enough, and -138 ap), Minjae 12.120.859 (not enough) and Guirassy 30.542.681 (enough, but -180 ap for +154 ap = a net LOSS of 26 fielded points plus the premium). Every route either leaves a negative balance at the lock - which scores ZERO for the entire matchday - or costs more points than it buys. killed_this_run.name: Keita Kosugi
killed_this_run.why: CLOSES OUT THE STANDING KOSUGI PLAN THAT Hmkgi49 SENT FORWARD FOR RE-PRICING. PhiL95 has RELISTED him, dt 2026-09-04T21:22:05Z, at prc 12.300.000 against mv 10.830.765 = +13,57%. That is a REPRICE DOWNWARD from the 12.676.617 / +15,20% Hmkgi49 recorded, so the ask is moving our way - and he is still a no. FITNESS AND SELECTION ARE FINE AND THAT IS NOT THE OBJECTION: bundesliga.com voraussichtliche Aufstellungen Spieltag 2, 04.09.2026, starts him for Frankfurt v Augsburg 06.09 15:30Z - "Atubolu - Baum, Koch, Brassier, KOSUGI - Amaimouni, Chaibi, Onyedika, Uzun - Ebnoutalib, Burkardt" - corroborated by a Yahoo Sports preview 04.09.2026 15:40Z whose Frankfurt injury list is only Doan, Knauff and Collins. st 0, mvt 2. He is a confirmed starting Bundesliga full-back. REJECTED ON MARGINAL POINTS PER EURO, WHICH IS THE ONLY NUMBER THAT MATTERS FOR A FIFTH DEFENDER. His ap is 64. Buying him takes the squad to 12 = 1GK/5DEF/4MID/2ATT whose best legal shape is 5-3-2, and he enters the eleven ahead of WIDMER 29 - so the real purchase is +35 FIELDED POINTS FOR 12.300.000 = 351k PER MARGINAL POINT. Set that against what is already on the table: Conte 3204 is +106 for 11.343.500 (107k per marginal point at the full bid) and Rohr 3284 is +87 for ~9.726.134 (112k). Kosugi is more than three times worse than both, on a mandate that optimises points. THE HEADLINE ap 64 IS NOT THE PURCHASE - the 35-point gap over the man he displaces is, and this is the same distinction that correctly killed Robin Koch (Aha9xcq, +103 for 24,2M) one run ago. HE IS ALSO NOT AFFORDABLE THIS RUN WITHOUT WRECKING THE PLAN: cash is 11.343.624 and 11.343.500 of it is already committed to the live Conte offer, so he needs the Conte bid pulled or a sale on top, and pulling a +106 to fund a +35 is self-evidently wrong. REVERSAL CONDITION: he becomes interesting only if (a) the ask falls under roughly 4M, i.e. near 110k per MARGINAL point over whoever he would actually displace, recomputed at that time rather than reused from here, AND (b) Georg has cash with no better claim on it, AND (c) he still projects as a Frankfurt starter on a source dated then. A further cut in PhiL95's ask is NOT by itself a reversal - the gap to close is roughly 8M, not 400k.

movers.reason: No flip is available. There are currently no manager asks priced below market value at all, so the mechanism a flip depends on is simply absent this run, and nothing on the board clears its own cost. Worth restating that the round-trips rivals keep running through the daily value tick are motion rather than points, and several involve players who are unavailable to play — not a model to copy.

fitness.sweep: A full dated sweep of the eleven found no new injury and no suspension, which matches the clean status flags coming back from the first-party data. Two things are worth carrying. First, a dated projection places our second-highest scorer on the bench for tomorrow's fixture, though the same source simultaneously talks him up and he started the opening matchday and scored heavily in a win — treated as unconfirmed, and it resolves tomorrow. Second, the centre-back selection risk we were already watching is confirmed as a genuine coin flip rather than a settled exclusion: one of the three is safe and our player is competing with another for the remaining slot, with reputable sources split on which way it goes. The sweep also caught three wrong forenames carried in our own records, which is exactly the kind of error that makes a search return nothing and a run wrongly conclude there is no news.
